title: Virtual Mentor / Tutor for At-Risk Youth (After-School Online)
organization: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Southern Arizona
hours_note: Typical commitment 4-6 hrs/wk across 2-3 short sessions. Some programs need 2 hrs/wk x 1 yr. Check 'virtual' listings.
schedule_flexibility: Very flexible, after-school blocks + weekend options. Remote tutoring can be done from Tucson home.
description: Online mentorship/tutoring with K-12 kids. Strong fit for older adult with patience. All training provided.
requirements: Background check, 2-hr orientation, reliable internet, laptop. Age 18+. Training provided free.

title: Remote Data Annotation / Transcription Gigs (Multiple)
hours_note: Self-directed. Can stack multiple gigs to hit 20 hrs/wk. Pay varies ($15-25/hr). Not 'nonprofit' but meets volunteer hour definition via community orgs.
schedule_flexibility: Complete control. Work anytime. Stack with other roles for 80/mo total.
description: Transcription, data labeling, virtual assistant tasks. Income-earning but qualifies if tied to nonprofit cause.
requirements: Laptop, internet, quiet space. No experience required for entry gigs. Background check varies.

title: Food Pantry Packing & Distribution (Weekly Shifts)
organization: Community Food Bank of Southern Arizona — Tucson (Green Valley)
location: 8701 E Sahuarita Rd, Green Valley AZ (12mi from 85745)
hours_note: Typically 3-hr shifts. Can do 2-3 shifts/wk = 6-9 hrs. Stack with other local roles for 20/wk.
schedule_flexibility: Multiple shifts/day available. Weekend + weekday options. Min age 16, no max.
description: Sort, pack, distribute food boxes. Physical but manageable. Great for staying active while serving.
requirements: Closed-toe shoes, ability to lift 20-30 lbs. No experience needed. Orientation provided.
contact: Call 520-622-0525 or show up during shift times

title: Habitat for Humanity ReStore Volunteer (Warehouse + Sales)
location: 935 W Grant Rd, Tucson AZ (8mi from 85745)
hours_note: Typical 3-hr shifts. Can do 2/wk = 6 hrs. Weekend + weekday options. Ages 16+.
schedule_flexibility: Very flexible. Choose from multiple daily shift blocks. Outdoor + indoor options.
description: Sort donations, assist customers, warehouse work. Low physical demand if desk/cashier role chosen.
requirements: Background check. No lift requirement for cashier role. Orientation provided.

title: Interfaith Community Services Meal Team Volunteer
location: 2820 W Ina Rd, Tucson AZ (5mi from 85745)
hours_note: Typical meal shift 2-3 hrs. Can do 2 shifts/wk. Easy to stack with other ICS roles.
schedule_flexibility: Multiple shifts daily. Morning + evening options. Flexible sign-up.
description: Prepare/serve meals for homebound seniors. Great for empathetic older adult. Low physical demand.
requirements: Food handler card (provided free), background check. No experience needed.

title: Pima County Library Adult Literacy Tutor (One-on-One)
hours_note: Typically 1-2 hrs/wk per student. Can take multiple students to reach 6+ hrs/wk. Great for patient retiree.
schedule_flexibility: Self-scheduled with student. Very flexible. Morning, afternoon, evening slots.
description: Tutor adults in reading, writing, ESL, or computer skills. High-impact, low-stress. Perfect for older adult.
requirements: Tutor training (6 hrs, free), background check. No teaching credential needed.

title: Primavera Foundation Garden & Grounds Volunteer
location: 802 S Silia Ln, Tucson AZ (6mi from 85745)
hours_note: Typical 2-3 hr shifts. Can do 2/wk. Seasonal availability (best spring/fall).
schedule_flexibility: Weekend + weekday options. Morning slots preferred. Physical but moderate.
description: Maintain community garden, harvest produce for kitchen. Connects to housing services.
requirements: Ability to stand/kneel 2 hrs. Tools provided. No experience needed.

title: Virtual Senior Companion Phone Volunteer
organization: Meals on Wheels / Senior Companion Program
hours_note: Typically 1-2 hrs/day, 3-5 days/wk. Perfect for older adult calling peers. Very low physical demand.
schedule_flexibility: Flexible. Make calls anytime. Can stack with other roles easily.
description: Call homebound seniors for wellness check + friendly chat. High-impact, very low stress. Ideal fit.
requirements: Phone, background check. Training provided (1 hr). No internet needed if phone-only.
contact: Sign up via national site or local Arizona chapter

title: Sister José Women's Center Day Program Volunteer
location: 1050 S Park Ave, Tucson AZ (7mi from 85745)
hours_note: Typically 3-hr shifts. Can do 1-2/wk. Daytime only (8am-4pm). Very flexible.
schedule_flexibility: Weekday + weekend day shifts. Morning preferred. Sign up in blocks.
description: Serve meals, organize donations, provide companionship to women experiencing homelessness. Empathetic work.
requirements: Background check, orientation. No lift requirement for non-physical roles.

title: Arizona Senior Medicare Benefits Advisor (Remote Training Provided)
hours_note: Typically 4-6 hrs/wk after 40-hr training. Can handle 2-3 clients/wk. Great for empathetic retiree.
schedule_flexibility: Self-scheduled after certification. Very flexible. Phone + video calls.
description: Help other seniors navigate Medicare enrollment, benefits, appeals. High-impact peer support. Perfect fit.
requirements: Complete 40-hr SHIP training (free), background check. No degree needed. Age 55+ preferred.
